review_candidates.title: Lead Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Independently manage complex network configurations, installations, upgrades, and infrastructure changes across global enterprise environments. Troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues involving routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN, data center, cloud connectivity, and network security. Lead advanced network troubleshooting and traffic analysis using monitoring platforms, telemetry, packet captures, and diagnostic tools. Support and maintain enterprise networking technologies,
eligibility_evidence: Support enterprise WAN, Internet, VPN, SD-WAN, and hybrid cloud connectivity across Azure and AWS environments.
Cloud and SD-WAN Networking: Experience supporting enterprise SD-WAN solutions and hybrid cloud networking environments, including Azure and AWS.
Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role requires strong technical expertise, independent problem-solving, and collaboration across global infrastructure and operations teams. Critical Troubleshooting: Expertise in independently diagnosing and resolving complex network incidents using packet analysis, logs, telemetry, and monitoring tools. Professional Experience: Typically 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, with CCNP Enterprise certification or equivalent practical expertise preferred.
